RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for  ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday,  the May 17, 2007/Vaisakha 27, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Prime Minister; Atomic Energy; Coal; Communications and
Information Technology; Development of North Eastern Region;
External Affairs; Housing and Urban Poverty Alleviation; Overseas
Indian Affairs; Panchayati Raj; Personnel, Public Grievances

Total number of questions — 20
190
Telecommunication towers in
rural areas
†*601. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are contemplating on installing
telecommunication towers in rural areas of
the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the number of villages likely to be
selected for the said purpsoe and the amount
likely to be spent on the same;
(d) whether it is also a fact that said
towers installed at present in rural areas
generally remain out of order; and
(e) if not, the details of said towers
installed during the last two years, State-
wise?
Mass Transit Systems
*602. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of URBAN DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of steps taken or proposed
to be taken for the successful
implementation of Mass Transit Systems
(rapid bus and rail based) in various parts of
the country while seeking rapid growth of
urban population and its deterioration impact
on urban transports;
(b) whether Government have received
any proposal from various parts of the
country;
(c) if so, the details thereof and
Government's response thereto;
(d) whether Government have made any
comprehensive project with regard to Mass
Transit Systems; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

191
MoU with States for capacity building
programme for PRIs
*603. SHRI C. RAMACHAND-
RAIAH: Will the Minister of
PANCHAYATI RAJ be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Central Government has
signed an MoU with the States to launch an
effective capacity building programme for
Panchayati Raj Institutions (PRIs) which in
turn would promote and implement the
drinking water schemes;
(b) if so, the schemes that are to be
implemented by PRIs and how much
financial outlay is earmarked for the same
in the year 2007-08;
(c) whether the PRIs would be entrusted
with the task of subsequent operation and
maintenance of the scheme;
(d) if so, how much additional work force
would be roped in; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Providing low cost housing
finance
*604. SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA: Will
the Minister of HOUSING AND URBAN
POVERTY ALLEVIATION be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have any policy
for providing low cost housing finance to
people from economically weaker sections;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Rural business hubs
*605. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of PANCHAYATI RAJ
be pleased to state:
(a) the action plan of Government to set
up rural business hubs to improve the
economy of the rural India;
(b) the status of Orissa State in
development of such hubs in the backward
region; and
(c) to what extent this initiative would
control rural influx to urban sector?
FDI in cruise shipping space
*606. SHRIMATI SUPRIYA SULE:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the draft policy, prepared by
a steering group headed by the Shipping and
Tourism Ministers has been considered by
the Committee of Secretaries for approval
of the Central Government;
(b) if so, whether the policy seeks to
encourage foreign direct investment in cruise
shipping space;
(c) if so, the other main aims of the policy;
(d) whether Government have approved
the same; and
(e) by what time it is likely to be
announced?
Correct estimate of poverty
*607. SHRI RAHUL BAJAJ:
SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) the technically correct estimate of
poverty in country during 2004-05 as there
are two estimates floating around, one of
22 per cent, which is being used generally

192
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
by the media and Government and another
of 27.5 per cent which the Economic Survey
states is the one that is comparable to the
figure of 36 per cent of 1993-94;
(b) if the latter is correct, whether it is a
fact that poverty in the last ten years has
reduced more slowly than in the 1980s; and
(c) if so, the reasons for which the figure
of 22 per cent is being used by Government?
Women deserted by NRI husbands
*608. SHRIMATI BRINDA KARAT:
Will the Minister of OVERSEAS INDIAN
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether any action has been taken
by Government to redress the plight of Indian
women deserted by their NRI husbands;

Total number of Questions — 155
1065
Setting up of new coastal nuclear
power stations
4587. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA: Will the  PRIME MINISTER
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are planning
to set up around five new coastal nuclear
power stations using high-end reactors of
1,000 MWe and above and the overall
capacity of each station could be ramped
upto almost 8,000 MWe;
(b) whether 12 member Site-Selection
Committee recommended locations for
setting up nuclear plants in the country;
(c) whether Government are also
considering a proposal to permit firms
registered under the Companies Act to build
nuclear plants and to allow entry of
international players in the energy sector;
and
(d) if so, by when a final decision in this
regard is likely to be taken?
Nuclear power stations in the
country
4588. PROF. P.J. KURIEN: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) the total number of nuclear power
stations in the country and their generation
capacity;
(b) the quantity of actual generation;
(c) the reasons for the gap if any and
the steps taken to ensure full capacity
generation;
(d) whether there is scientifically
foolproof method of waste disposal
management;
(e) if so, the details thereof; and
(f) if not, the reasons therefor?

1066
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Coastal nuclear power station in
Orissa
4589. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
 Will the  PRIME MINISTER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is proposed to set up five
coastal nuclear power stations;
(b) if so, the details thereof, indicating
the amount of power each of it would
produce;
(c) whether any such station would also
be set up in Orissa coast; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Atomic power plant in M.P.
†4590. MISS ANUSUIYA UIKEY: Will
the  PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether a proposal to set up an
atomic power plant in Madhya Pradesh is
under consideration;
(b) if so, what would be its production
capacity;
(c) the quantum of power, State-wise,
to be provided from this plant;
(d) by when it would be approved;
and
(e) what would be the cost of it?
Discussion with International Atomic
Energy Agency
†4591. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD: Will the  PRIME MINISTER
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that discussion
of Indian representatives is still continuing
with International Atomic Energy Agency
(IAEA);
(b) if so, the main issue of discussion;
(c) whether it is a fact that success of
this discussion depends upon success of
implementation of atomic agreement that
was entered into on 18th July, 2005
between India and America; and
(d) if not, the Government's reaction in
this regard?
Overhauling of coal distribution
system
4592. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
SHRIMATI SUPRIYA
SULE:
Will the  PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the country's coal
distribution system is set for an overhaul
and is likely to be based on the needs of
regulated and  non-regulated sectors and
the committee for evaluation of policy for
distribution headed by the Coal Secretary
has been appointed to formulate the new
policy;
(b) the main recommendations made;
(c) whether to increase the  availability
of coal having high utilizable heat value,
Coal India Limited has decided to set up a
washery in all new mines that would be
opened up from now; and
(d) by when a final decision in this
regard is likely to be taken?
Coal-mining blocks to private
sector
4593. MS. MABEL REBELLO: Will
the  PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) the total number of coal blocks
which have been given to the private sector,
till date, for mining;

1067
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) the names of the parties with size of
the coal blocks reserve in terms of million
tonnes;
(c) the number of private parties who
have started mining coal for their own use
since these blocks have been given on
captive basis;
(d) Government's action thereto with
the private parties who have not started
using these coal-mining blocks; and
(e) whether his Ministry have any plan
to cancel these blocks?
Shifting of headquarter of NE
coalfields
†4594. SHRI AJAY MAROO: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal to
shift the headquarter of North-Eastern
coalfields from Guwahati to some other
place;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the view-point of Government in
this regard?
Increase in BSNL towers
4595. SHRI NANDI YELL
